intro: The marketing for Granite Crude promises automation, accuracy and speed. Its own pages also carry placeholders, conflicting lists and claims no third party verifies. This review keeps the pitch and the paperwork separate.

The product is browser-based: AI and algorithmic models analyse markets, surface signals and suggest entries, with automatic or manual execution. Registration is free, the demo runs alongside, and the minimum deposit sits at US$250.

We graded Granite Crude on the same five dimensions as every review on this site: ease of use, features, transparency, security and support. The number below is ours, and the evidence sits in the sections above it.
whatItClaims: Risk settings adjustable before the first live trade.
A partner broker holding funds and executing orders.
Withdrawals processed in under a day, per the page.
No prior trading experience required.
AI and algorithmic market analysis producing signals and suggested entries.
whatWeChecked: The withdrawal path: steps and any fees the page omits.
The ownership trail: who operates the platform and where.
The support channels: live chat, email or phone availability.
The fine print: clauses that qualify the headline promises.
The fee framing: no platform fees, but spreads embedded in every trade.
The support story: around-the-clock coverage claimed, exact figures conflicting.

Free registration and a demo account.
cons: Marketing numbers that the fine print walks back.
redFlags: Return claims without verification.
The fee that is not a fee: spreads embedded in every trade.
Restriction lists that name different countries.

faqs.q: Is it really fee-free?
faqs.a: The platform fee is absent, but every trade carries a broker spread the page itself calls the real cost. The headline says free; the fine print says otherwise. Budget for the fine print.

faqs.q: How fast are withdrawals?
faqs.a: The page promises payouts within a day, but the processing detail is thin. Confirm the exact timeline and any fees with support before funding anything.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: What is the minimum deposit?
faqs.a: US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

faqs.q: Is Granite Crude safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

bottomLine: Granite Crude reads as a functioning AI trading service with the standard package, and the product itself clears the bar for a cautious trial.
Our 4.6 reflects what the pages publish and what they skip. It is not a warning off - it is a reminder to trade the product, not the pitch.
